name: naiwa-backrooms
description: 奶蛙后室 · Level 0 — 独立版 3D 后室小游戏（three.js 光线风格第一人称）

scripts.optimize:models: node scripts/prepare-models.mjs && gltf-transform optimize naiwa/backrooms3d/naidan.glb .build/naidan.glb --compress quantize --simplify false --texture-compress webp && gltf-transform optimize naiwa/backrooms3d/naishu.glb .build/naishu.glb --compress quantize --simplify false --texture-compress webp
scripts.dev: npm run build && python -m http.server 8950 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
